## Tubular Revived 0.29.3

Based on NewPipe 0.29.3 (extractor 202612, NewPipe Extractor 0.27.1).

- New: sort local playlists by title or duration, or reverse the playlist order (menu > Sort). Sorting only changes the display and play order, the stored playlist order is not modified.
- Fix: Bandcamp search works under a non-English content language.
- New: SoundCloud aac_96k audio streams.
